title: Not that impressed
text: Not that impressed. I can't say I'm that impressed with this heater. I use it for a medium-large size room, not open concept (like a large bedroom). It doesn't heat it very well and I often us a small electric heater right behind me in addition to this oil heater just to stay warm. With the good reviews and at over $100 I was hoping for a lot better considering it says it can heat a large room.
